turns.customer: I finally took the Ridgeline Low shoes from order #1052 out of the box and the sole is coming away from the upper on the left shoe. Can I get a refund?
turns.reply: I’m sorry the shoe arrived damaged. Our policy requires damage to be reported within 14 days of delivery, and this order was delivered 45 days ago, so we can’t process an immediate refund. I’ve escalated your case to a human support agent (ticket ESC-50); they will follow up by email within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
